subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should malformed SKILL.md diagnostics be accepted as a repaired skills lint command first, or must normal list/check/status/Web surfaces expose skipped candidates before this issue can close?
rationale: The implementation boundary changes user-facing diagnostics, local path/error disclosure, and whether the existing open PR is complete enough, so automation should not decide the permanent product surface.

options.title: Use Lint-First Scope
options.body: Repair and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92028 as the first native diagnostic surface, then explicitly track any remaining list/status/Web work if maintainers still want it.

options.title: Require All Requested Surfaces
options.body: Broaden or replace the candidate implementation so normal CLI status/list/check and Web skill views also show skipped malformed candidates before closing this issue.

options.title: Limit To Authoring Tools
options.body: Treat runtime/status diagnostics as out of scope and rely on skill-creator or ClawHub validation flows, leaving normal skill loading silent for malformed local candidates.

recommendation.title: Use Lint-First Scope
recommendation.body: Repair and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92028 as the first native diagnostic surface, then explicitly track any remaining list/status/Web work if maintainers still want it.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest adjacent history across skills CLI, parser/docs, and maintainer-visible scoping for related validation issues.
